methods.name: getSavedPrinters
methods.docs: Returns all printers saved persistently on the device for automatic reconnection.

methods.name: reconnectSavedPrinter
methods.docs: Explicitly reconnects to a previously saved printer.

methods.name: clearSavedPrinter
methods.docs: Clears saved printer info for one transport or all transports.

methods.name: htmlToImage
methods.docs: Natively renders an HTML structure into a PNG or JPEG Base64 image.

methods.name: htmlToPdf
methods.docs: Natively converts an HTML structure into a multi-page or receipt PDF (Base64 + optional saved filePath).

methods.name: printHtmlNative
methods.signature: (options: HtmlNativePrintOptions) => Promise<{ printed: boolean; jobName: string; }>
methods.docs:
Opens the device's native print dialog (Android Print Framework / iOS AirPrint) for an HTML document.
Supports office/home Wi-Fi printers (HP, Canon, Epson, Brother) and Save as PDF.

methods.name: printHtmlToThermal
methods.docs:
Natively renders HTML (with CSS & Bangla/Unicode fonts) to an image and prints directly to a
Bluetooth, USB, Thermal, or Network thermal receipt printer (with auto-reconnect, optional cut & cash drawer).

properties.name: html
properties.docs: HTML string or fragment (supports CSS, tables, logos, Bangla/Arabic/Unicode fonts).

properties.name: width
properties.docs: Output image width in pixels (default: 576; use 384 for 58mm thermal, 576 for 80mm thermal, 794 for A4).

properties.name: format
properties.docs: Output image format: 'png' (default) or 'jpeg'.

properties.name: quality
properties.docs: JPEG compression quality 1-100 (default: 90).

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.docs: Optional base URL for resolving relative image/CSS assets.

properties.name: delayMs
properties.docs: Extra delay in milliseconds after page load before capturing (useful for web fonts/remote images, default: 150).

properties.name: html
properties.docs: HTML string or fragment to convert into a PDF document.

properties.name: pageSize
properties.docs: Page size preset (default: 'A4'). Use 'Receipt58mm' or 'Receipt80mm' for continuous receipt PDFs.

properties.name: orientation
properties.docs: Page orientation (default: 'portrait').

properties.name: customWidthPt
properties.docs: Custom page width in points (72 pt = 1 inch), used when pageSize is 'custom'.

properties.name: customHeightPt
properties.docs: Custom page height in points (72 pt = 1 inch), used when pageSize is 'custom'.

properties.name: marginPt
properties.docs: Page margin in points on all sides (default: 24 for standard pages, 4 for receipt presets).

properties.name: fileName
properties.docs: Optional output file name (e.g., 'invoice-101.pdf'). When set or when saveToFile is true, saves PDF to app cache.

properties.name: saveToFile
properties.docs: Whether to save the generated PDF to a local temporary/cache file and return filePath (default: false).

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.docs: Optional base URL for resolving relative assets.

properties.name: delayMs
properties.docs: Extra delay in milliseconds after page load before rendering PDF (default: 150).

properties.name: html
properties.docs:
HTML string or fragment to print via the OS native print dialog (Android Print Framework / iOS AirPrint).
Works with Wi-Fi office printers (HP, Canon, Epson, Brother), Mopria, AirPrint, and Save as PDF.

properties.name: jobName
properties.docs: Print job name shown in the OS print dialog (default: 'ZPrinter Document').

properties.name: pageSize
properties.docs: Suggested paper size (default: 'A4').

properties.name: orientation
properties.docs: Suggested orientation (default: 'portrait').

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.docs: Optional base URL for resolving relative assets.

properties.name: html
properties.docs: HTML string or fragment (supports full CSS, tables, logos, and Bangla/Arabic/Unicode text).

properties.name: printerType
properties.docs: Target thermal printer transport.

properties.name: width
properties.docs: Print width in pixels (default: 384 for 58mm printers; use 576 for 80mm printers).

properties.name: align
properties.docs: Alignment on the thermal roll (default: 'center').

properties.name: threshold
properties.docs: Grayscale threshold 0-255 (default: 128).

properties.name: mode
properties.docs: 'raster' (GS v 0, default) or 'bitImage' (ESC * 33 for very old ESC/POS printers).

properties.name: feedLines
properties.docs: Blank lines to feed after printing (default: 2).

properties.name: cut
properties.docs: Automatically cut paper after printing (default: false).

properties.name: partialCut
properties.docs: Use partial cut when cut is true (default: false).

properties.name: kickDrawer
properties.docs: Automatically kick cash drawer after printing (default: false).

properties.name: drawerPin
properties.docs: Cash drawer pin when kickDrawer is true: 0 (Pin 2, default) or 1 (Pin 5).

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.docs: Optional base URL for resolving relative assets.

properties.name: delayMs
properties.docs: Extra delay in milliseconds after HTML load before capturing (default: 150).

properties.name: encoding
properties.docs:
Character encoding for legacy/international ESC/POS printers (default: 'UTF-8').
Examples: 'CP437', 'CP850', 'CP858', 'ISO-8859-1', 'GBK', 'UTF-8'.

properties.name: codePage
properties.docs: Optional ESC/POS hardware character code table (ESC t n), e.g. 0 (PC437), 2 (PC850), 16 (WPC1252).

properties.name: reset
properties.docs: Send ESC @ reset command before printing (default: true).

properties.name: width
properties.docs:
Target width in pixels (e.g., 384 for 58mm printers, 576 for 80mm printers).
If only width is provided, height scales proportionally.

properties.name: threshold
properties.docs: Grayscale threshold between 0 and 255 (default: 128).

properties.name: mode
properties.docs:
'raster' uses GS v 0 (default, fastest on modern printers).
'bitImage' uses ESC * 33 (compatibility mode for very old ESC/POS printers).

properties.name: feedLines
properties.docs: Blank lines to feed after printing the image (default: 1).

properties.name: height
properties.docs: Barcode height in dots (1-255, default: 80).

properties.name: width
properties.docs: Barcode module width (2-6, default: 2).

properties.name: hriPosition
properties.docs: Human-readable text placement (default: 'below').

properties.name: base64
properties.docs: Base64-encoded raw command bytes (ESC/POS, TSPL, ZPL, CPCL, Star, etc.).

properties.name: bytes
properties.docs: Array of unsigned byte values (0-255).

properties.name: text
properties.docs: Plain command text encoded as UTF-8 (useful for TSPL/ZPL/CPCL label printers).

properties.name: pin
properties.docs: Cash drawer connector pin: 0 (Pin 2, default) or 1 (Pin 5).

properties.name: onTime
properties.docs: Pulse ON duration (0-255, default: 25).

properties.name: offTime
properties.docs: Pulse OFF duration (0-255, default: 250).

properties.name: partial
properties.docs: Perform a partial cut instead of a full cut (default: false).

properties.name: feedLines
properties.docs: Feed lines before cutting so the last line of text is not clipped (default: 3).

properties.name: forget
properties.docs: If true, also clears the saved printer so it will not auto-reconnect on future prints (default: false).

properties.name: timeout
properties.docs: Connection timeout in milliseconds (default: 5000).
